title: Handover
description: The dispatch envelope: metadata header of a `dispatch_handover_v1` fenced block. The runtime-layer handover validator enforces the metadata contract.

oneOf.description: Canonical form: isolation_level present, legacy trio absent.
Legacy form (backward compat): legacy trio present, isolation_level absent.

executor.description: Editing source-of-truth: core/policy/executor-enum.yaml. Keep in sync.

dispatch_route.description: Editing source-of-truth: core/policy/dispatch-routes.yaml. Keep in sync.

brief_file.description: Absolute path; main thread writes via mktemp -p /tmp brief-<slug>-XXXXXX.md mode 0600.

isolation_level.description: Canonical isolation intent. Adapter layer translates to executor-native flags. Cannot be mixed with legacy sandbox/approval/skip_git_check fields. Source of truth: core/policy/isolation-level.yaml. isolation_level:none is not accepted on main_thread_bash_background route (maps to danger-full-access).

sandbox.description: Legacy field, accepted when isolation_level is absent (backward compat for pre-M3 briefs). New briefs must use isolation_level instead.

approval.description: Legacy field, accepted when isolation_level is absent. Validator rejects values other than never for the bash route.

model.description: PM-facing alias OR wire id OR `default`. Aliases resolved via share/model-aliases.tsv.

skip_git_check.description: Legacy field, accepted when isolation_level is absent. Validator hard-rejects true on the bash route.

snapshot_file.description: Optional. Path to a PM-generated context snapshot. Agent uses it for orientation; security-sensitive fields (branch, SHA) must be re-derived from git before being acted upon.
